deviations_from_card: (1) The title-block rebinding lives in base/tokens.css as [data-variant="blocks"] .bk-title-block, not at foot.css:60: otherwise foot.css would have to read ramp steps to bind the roles, which contradicts the zero-ramp ratchet, and the card's expected impact says one edit in tokens.css. foot.css:60 .bk-title-block now paints the block from its own roles (background/color/border = --bk-ground/--bk-ink/--bk-ground). The no-fork case is checked as written (no rule under '.bk-title-block ' declares a colour). (2) Twelve roles, not ten: --bk-ink-faint keeps the resting scrollbar thumb at graphite-4 (else that paint moves), and --bk-ink-on-redline keeps the armed hover's figure sheet-coloured in both scopes. Both are in both sets, and the completeness test asserts the ten named are present and the two sets are equal. (3) Guard 4: the gate's button at rest now resolves to the block's ground (#1d1c1a) instead of 'none'. Same pixels and same hover transition; the guard accepts none or exactly the scope ground. (4) The AUTO stripe rule also names its :hover:not(:disabled) state, because the unified hover now sets border-color (the gate needs it) and would otherwise repaint the greenline stripe. Pinned by the stock guard. (5) The band rule (body.css) and the arm frame read --bk-ink, not --bk-line-strong: in the gate the band rule is sheet while a button edge is graphite-3, so line-strong binds graphite-3 there and the band rule takes its lettering's ink. (6) body.css had 9 ramp reads at base, not the card's 11, so the migrated eight totalled 102.
notes: ADR 0198 claimed under the lock (0197 was taken by ledgerbox). The webkit scrollbar track and thumb border inside the title block now follow the scope (graphite, not vellum). Chromium ignores ::-webkit-scrollbar wherever scrollbar-color is set, and this sheet sets it on every element, so nothing visible changes. No sibling reds seen. Slot B: rulesOf() is unchanged. The new helpers paint(key, prop, scope), declOf, partsOf (a paren-aware selector split) and groundsOf are in the test file for B's forced-colors gate to build on. B should skip its @media (forced-colors) block in paint(); paint() already ignores any rule with r.at !== "".
